cards.text: Once again the Philistines go to war against Israel, and David and his servants go down and fight them. And then the king gets EXHAUSTED. Friend, I get winded pressing one tray of dough, so I am not judging anybody.
Then here comes Ishbi-benob, a descendant of Rapha, with a bronze spear that weighs three hundred shekels and a brand NEW sword. Nobody brings fresh gear to a fight just to show it off.

cards.question: With David worn out, what is Ishbi-benob set on doing?
David is exhausted, and Ishbi-benob is coming for him. Who comes to David's aid?

cards.text: Abishai son of Zeruiah, one of David's fighting men, strikes the Philistine and kills him. Then David's men gather around their king with something serious to say.

cards.question: After that close call, what do David's men swear to him?

answers.text: He must never go to battle with them again
They will always fight right beside him
He must lead them from the very front

cards.text: Their reason: "so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished." Friend, that is the most beautiful way anybody has ever said "Sir, please SIT DOWN."
Some time later, there's another battle with the Philistines, this time at Gob. Sibbecai the Hushathite kills a man named Saph.

cards.question: Like Ishbi-benob, Saph is a descendant of Rapha.

cards.text: Then there's ANOTHER battle at Gob, because apparently Gob is where everybody meets up now. Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite kills the brother of a famous Philistine, and this verse has a spear in it with a shaft like a weaver's beam.

cards.question: At Gob, Elhanan son of Jair kills the brother of which famous Philistine?

cards.text: Next comes a battle at Gath, with a man of great stature. Six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, and here I am with a MUSTACHE for hands, feeling some kind of way.

cards.question: With six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, how many fingers and toes does the man at Gath have in all?

cards.text: He too is descended from Rapha, and this man does NOT keep his mouth shut when it comes to Israel.

cards.question: The man of great stature at Gath ___ Israel.
When the man at Gath taunts Israel, who kills him?

answers.text: Jonathan son of David's brother Shimei
Amasa son of David's sister Abigail
Absalom son of David's wife Maacah

cards.question: Counting every battle in this passage, how many descendants of Rapha fall?

cards.text: So these four descendants of Rapha in Gath fall at the hands of David and his servants. My backup in the junk drawer was a couple of dead batteries swearing they still had a little charge left, so friend, I am JEALOUS of David's team.
